Built and analysed a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of a 4×40 m continuous precast T-girder bridge (16 m deck, 6 C50 girders/span).

Modeling decisions:
- structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d (MR-01); structure.system = continuous (MR-05, made-continuous unit, no pier-column data).
- Girder section (T-girder, single) integrated: A = 1.022 m², I = 0.85655 m⁴; 6 girders → girder.A = 6.132 m², girder.I = 5.13933 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (C50), γ = 26 kN/m³; w = 159.432 kN/m, m = 16.252 t/m (MR-07).

Sliding PTFE at supports 0, 1, 3, 4 (longitudinal free, Kh = 0); plain fixed at support 2 (longitudinal spring, Kh = 22500 kN/m). Vertical spring, rotation free (MR-03, JTG3362-8.7).
- Lane load (Class I, one-way, 15 m carriageway): 4 design lanes, ξ = 0.67, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 340 kN per span (L0 = 40 m). Modal f1 = 3.241 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.192 (JTG D60-4.3.2).
